page.overview:
Who is Rakushitemo Terusubehainaika?

Dr. Rakushitemo Terusubehainaika is a scientist and a member of the Germ Pirates.

Terusubehainaika is an average-sized man with blond hair and a short blond beard. He wears a dark green coat with yellow straps, light brown pants, and dark brown boots.

Terusubehainaika has no interest in piracy, and only joined the Germ Pirates in order to put his research to the test.

Terusubehainaika is a mad scientist who developed the Kiss-Kiss Germ, indicating that he has significant medical expertise.
